name: Sunlord-swpa
title: SWPA series wire-wound shielded SMD power inductors, 2.5×2.0 mm to 8.0×8.0 mm
summary: A family of wire-wound surface-mount power inductors on a ferrite core with metallised terminations, shielded by a magnetic resin over a closed magnetic path. Twenty body sizes run from 2.5×2.0×1.0 mm to 8.0×8.0×6.5 mm and values from 0.22 μH to 680 μH. Each part is specified for DC resistance, minimum self-resonant frequency, saturation current at a 30 % inductance drop and the DC current that gives a 40 °C rise, and the series runs from -40 °C to +125 °C, self-heating included.

pins.function: One end of the winding, brought out to a metallised pad on the underside.
The other end of the winding, on the opposite pad.

where.Isat: saturation current: the DC bias that pulls L down about 30 %
where.Irms: DC current that raises the part 40 °C above a 20 °C ambient

operation.text: The winding sits on a ferrite core whose terminations are metallised directly on the core, which makes the part robust against mechanical shock. A magnetic resin fills round the winding and closes the flux path, so stray field, EMI and audible buzz stay very low.

Two limits apply. Isat marks where the core begins to saturate (inductance down about 30 %); Irms marks where self-heating reaches a 40 °C rise. The usable rating of a part is whichever is lower. Both are given as a maximum and a typical figure.
The -40 °C to +125 °C operating range includes the part's own heating.
The 252010S, 252012S, 3010S, 3012S and 3015S series carry no marking; every larger series has a mark on its top face.
Intended for power conversion in phones, smart TVs, set-top boxes, notebooks, car navigation, telecom base stations, VR and AR headsets and LED lighting.
All parts ship on carrier tape (packing code T).
